results.description: E2 face verification: FAR / FRR / EER, by subgroup
results.data_needed: >=100 subjects; per subject 1 enrolment session (>=15 aligned face crops) and >=10 probe crops across 2 lighting conditions and >=2 devices; optional self-reported subgroups.
notes: face embedder not configured (FACE_EMBEDDER); only legacy_histogram evaluated

results.description: E2 liveness: APCER per attack type and BPCER (ISO/IEC 30107-3 style)
results.data_needed: >=50 subjects x {bona fide, printed photo, phone-screen replay, laptop video replay}; landmark series JSON per attempt.
notes: No manifest at eval/data/liveness/manifest.jsonl. Not measured.

results.description: E3 speaker verification EER and spoof acceptance, by accent
results.data_needed: >=100 speakers (mostly Indian-English), 3 sessions, >=2 devices; replay and TTS-clone probes made only from each consenting speaker's own voice.

results.description: E4 lip-sync verification: AUC / EER separating genuine from mismatched clips
results.data_needed: >=100 subjects x 5 genuine 10-20 s clips (16 kHz WAV plus per-frame face landmarks JSON); constructed negatives (other-speaker audio, +/-100-500 ms offsets, playback while silent) labelled with mismatch_kind.
notes: No manifest at eval/data/lipsync/manifest.jsonl. Not measured.

results.description: E5 gaze: off-screen precision / recall and Cohen's kappa vs human annotation
results.data_needed: >=30 subjects x 2 min interview-style video, per-frame landmarks plus on/off-screen labels from 2 annotators (disagreements removed or adjudicated).
notes: No manifest at eval/data/gaze/manifest.jsonl. Not measured.

results.description: ASR corpus WER, overall and per accent
results.data_needed: >=2 h of interview-style answers from >=50 speakers with human reference transcripts; accent subgroup per speaker.
notes: No manifest at eval/data/asr/manifest.jsonl. Not measured.

results.description: E6 question relevance as rated by experts, per generator version
results.data_needed: 200 generated questions from >=40 consented, de-identified resume/JD pairs, each rated 1-5 by 3 experts.

results.description: E6/E9 answer-score agreement with human raters (Spearman, QWK), by subgroup
results.data_needed: >=300 answers from >=60 consenting candidates, each rated 1-5 on the published rubric by >=3 trained raters.
notes: No manifest at eval/data/answer_scoring/manifest.jsonl. Not measured.

results.description: LLM structured-output validity before and after validation/fallback
results.data_needed: Exported LLM call log from staging or E2E runs (consent_id = 'system' for synthetic sessions).

results.description: E7 phone / second-person detection precision and recall
results.data_needed: >=500 annotated frames from consented sessions; predictions exported from the detector.

results.description: End-to-end latency p50 / p95 per stage (target: first avatar frame p95 < 1.5 s)
results.data_needed: Latency events exported from instrumented sessions (API /metrics/latency export).
notes: No manifest at eval/data/latency/manifest.jsonl. Not measured.

results.description: Avatar lip-sync quality (LSE-D lower is better, LSE-C higher is better)
results.data_needed: 100 generated clips per avatar path scored with the SyncNet evaluation script (weights licence must be checked before use).
notes: No manifest at eval/data/avatar_sync/manifest.jsonl. Not measured.
